sources.title: Whisper large-v3-turbo - til
sources.snippet: Unlike Distil-Whisper, which used distillation to train a smaller model, Whisper turbo was fine-tuned for two more epochs over the same amount of multilingual transcription data used for training large-v3, i.e. excluding translation data, on which we don't expect turbo to perform well.
